title: The unit-normalized tensor comparison for an isomorphic base change
statement: Let g:X→Y be an isomorphism of schemes, O a sheaf of commutative rings on Y_proet, and F,G sheaves of O-modules. Use the inverse image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and the sheaf tensor of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There are isomorphisms σ(F,G):g⁻¹(F⊗_O G)≅g⁻¹F⊗_{g⁻¹O}g⁻¹G. They send the inverse-image unit section of s⊗t to the pure tensor of the unit sections of s and t. They are natural in F: for a:F→F', g⁻¹(a⊗id) followed by σ(F',G) equals σ(F,G) followed by g⁻¹a⊗id. The unit-section and mixed-universe conventions are those of [def-pur-inverse-image-tensor-hom-sections].

proof.text: Apply the invertibility, pure-tensor normalization and joint naturality clauses of [lem-pur-proetale-inverse-image-tensor-comparison] with h=g and the extra composable morphism equal to id_X. Turn the invertible comparison morphisms into isomorphisms. Specialize joint naturality to b=id_G. The second-factor tensor map of an identity is identity by the sectionwise tensor extensionality and functoriality of sheafification.
